defects.description: The heading "Network Servers" is translated as "Сеть Серверы", which is ungrammatical and unnatural in Russian.
The term "Origin" is translated as "Начало", which does not convey the intended meaning of the zone origin.
The phrase "Блок IP-адресов требует записей Обратная запись DNS (IP в имя хоста)" is grammatically incorrect; the word order and case are wrong.
